title: Inventory · client 23.1.3
hint: Complete progress slots are stored on the server. A module is stored as linked records in ModuleStorage (slot 27), ModulePoint (slot 26.c/1155), and ModulesInfo (slot 37). Direct module records in 26.s/26.u are not used. Other unverified records are read-only. Client item names are in English; a technical ID is shown when a name was not extracted. Original progress data is preserved without loss.

grantWarning: The selected parameters replace current values. Consumable quantity is the final amount, not an increment.

bulkGrantWearHint: Adds missing masks, headgear, boots, and capes. Existing items are unchanged.

bulkGrantGadgetsHint: Adds missing gadgets at the selected level. Existing gadgets and their levels are unchanged.
bulkGrantPetsHint: Adds missing level 1 pets without cards or custom names. Existing pets are unchanged.
bulkRevokeHint: Removes supported ownership records. Equipped and unverified items remain. Currency, experience, and other account data are not reset.

bulkGrantModulesHint: Adds only missing modules at the selected level from 1 to 10. Linked ModuleStorage, ModulePoint, and ModulesInfo records are created atomically for each module. Existing modules and their levels are unchanged.
